title: CPF Module Schema: Virtual Network Gateway Connection module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-virtualnetworkgatewayconnection'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

authorization_key.description: (Required) Authorization key of express route circuit

connection_mode.description: (Optional) Connection mode to use. Possible values are Default, InitiatorOnly and ResponderOnly

connection_name.description: (Required) Name of the express route connection

connection_protocol.description: (Optional) The IKE protocol version to use. Possible values are IKEv1 and IKEv2, : Only valid for IPSec connections on virtual network gateways with SKU VpnGw1, VpnGw2, VpnGw3, VpnGw1AZ, VpnGw2AZ or VpnGw3AZ

connection_type.description: (Required)The type of connection. Valid options are IPsec (Site-to-Site), ExpressRoute (ExpressRoute), and Vnet2Vnet (VNet-to-VNet).

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

custom_bgp_addresses.description: (Optional) Custom BGP address object({ primary = (Required) primary bgp address secondary = (Required) secodnary bgp address })

dpd_timeout_seconds.description: (Optional) The dead peer detection timeout of this connection in seconds

egress_nat_rule_ids.description: (Optional) A list of the egress NAT Rule Ids.

enable_bgp.description: (Optional) If true, BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) is enabled for this connection

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

express_route_circuit_id.description: (Required) The id of express route circuit

express_route_gateway_bypass.description: (Optional) If true, data packets will bypass ExpressRoute Gateway for data forwarding This is only valid for ExpressRoute connections.

gw_connection_shared_key.description: (Optional) The shared IPSec key. A key could be provided if a Site-to-Site, VNet-to-VNet or ExpressRoute connection is created

ingress_nat_rule_ids.description: (Optional) A list of the ingress NAT Rule Ids.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

ipsec_policy.type: object({ dh_group = string ike_encryption = string ike_integrity = string ipsec_encryption = string ipsec_integrity = string pfs_group = string sa_datasize = string sa_lifetime = string })
ipsec_policy.description: (Optional) ipsec policy object({ dh_group = (Required) The DH group used in IKE phase 1 for initial SA. Valid options are DHGroup1, DHGroup14, DHGroup2, DHGroup2048, DHGroup24, ECP256, ECP384, or None. ike_encryption = (Required) The IKE encryption algorithm. Valid options are AES128, AES192, AES256, DES, DES3, GCMAES128, or GCMAES256. ike_integrity = (Required) The IKE integrity algorithm. Valid options are GCMAES128, GCMAES256, MD5, SHA1, SHA256, or SHA384. ipsec_encryption = (Required) The IPSec encryption algorithm. Valid options are AES128, AES192, AES256, DES, DES3, GCMAES128, GCMAES192, GCMAES256, or None. ipsec_integrity = (Required) The IPSec integrity algorithm. Valid options are GCMAES128, GCMAES192, GCMAES256, MD5, SHA1, or SHA256. pfs_group = (Required) The DH group used in IKE phase 2 for new child SA. Valid options are ECP256, ECP384, PFS1, PFS14, PFS2, PFS2048, PFS24, PFSMM, or None. sa_datasize = (Required) The IPSec SA payload size in KB. Must be at least 1024 KB. Defaults to 102400000 KB. sa_lifetime = (Required) The IPSec SA lifetime in seconds. Must be at least 300 seconds. Defaults to 27000 seconds. })

local_azure_ip_address_enabled.description: (Optional) Use private local Azure IP for the connection.

local_network_gateway_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the local network gateway when creating Site-to-Site connection

peer_virtual_network_gateway_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the peer virtual network gateway when creating a VNet-to-VNet connection (i.e. when type is Vnet2Vnet).

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

traffic_selector_policy.description: (Optional)traffic selector policy object({ local_address_cidrs = (Required) List of local CIDRs. remote_address_cidrs = (Required) List of remote CIDRs. })

use_policy_based_traffic_selectors.description: (Optional) If true, policy-based traffic selectors are enabled for this connection. Enabling policy-based traffic selectors requires an ipsec_policy

virtual_network_gateway_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Virtual Network Gateway in which the connection will be created

resource.description: The Virtual Network gateway connection resource

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Virtualnetworkgatewayconnection' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
